TUIOS is a Go-based terminal multiplexer and window manager that enhances productivity with a vim-like interface, BSP tiling, and advanced features for managing coding agents. It offers persistent sessions, cross-machine connectivity, and an inbox for agent communication, all within the terminal.

Strata is a C++ inference engine that allows users to run the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI model on consumer hardware, such as Windows or Linux PCs with NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards. It provides an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API on localhost and supports optional image input, ensuring all processing remains on the user's machine.

git-secret is a bash tool designed to securely store sensitive data within a Git repository. It encrypts files using the public keys of authorized users, ensuring that only those with the corresponding private keys can decrypt and access the information. This simplifies access management and revoking permissions without needing to re-encrypt all secrets.
